correctness.rationale: Explicit thirty-vertex conflict graph construction exactly encodes a third edge joining chosen endpoints. A standard independent-set recursion gives coefficient vectors (1,30,225,530,330) for L(P) and (1,30,235,580,415) for L(C5 square K2), with zero coefficient for sizes >=5. A second independent graph realization and direct enumeration of all candidates through size five reproduce those vectors. The S5 coordinate action enumerates and partitions all 330 optimum sets into 30,60,120,120. Proof and reproducible programs are embedded.

value.rationale: The result computes complete canonical edge-interference enumerators for two naturally comparable line graphs of ten-vertex cubic graphs. Their equality of maximum four but differing all other nontrivial counts is a graph-structural distinction, while the four S5-orbit classification of the Petersen optimum sets explains nontrivial optimizer multiplicity. It is a finite motivated classification, not a routine bound substitution.
